segments.t: Rain taps against the lobby windows of Courtyard Inn in Chengdu. With a second Room 7 guest arriving in thirty-five minutes, Manager Zhou, Qing, and Chen hurry toward the stairs. Listen first.
只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
阁楼里真的有像样的床吗？
有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
只有三个小纸箱！最多四个！
四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
快走——看看谁先到三楼！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
'Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!' Online review word to know:
差评
pairs 'poor' with 'rating' for a bad review, opposite of 'good-rating'.
深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
'Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.' Calming three-character phrase:
深呼吸
literally says 'deeply breathe out-and-in', working as 'take a deep breath'.
阁楼里真的有像样的床吗？
'Does the attic really have a proper bed?' Everyday praise word:
像样
literally means 'resembling a proper model'—decent, presentable, up to scratch.
那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
'Then why do we never rent it out to guests?' Combining 'rent' with 'give' forms
租给
marking the guest who receives the rented room.
因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
'Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.' Linking two reasons smoothly uses
而且
meaning 'and what is more' or 'besides'.
只有三个小纸箱！最多四个！
'Only three small cardboard boxes! Four at most!' Putting 'most' before 'many' builds
最多
meaning 'at most' when Zhou sheepishly admits to a fourth box.
四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
'We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!' Putting 'walk-away' onto 'move' gives
搬走
showing heavy boxes getting carried clear out of the room.
上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
'Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.' Direction pattern:
往左拐
says 'toward left turn', the exact formula you use for street and hallway directions. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
阁楼里真的有像样的床吗？
有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
只有三个小纸箱！最多四个！
四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
快走——看看谁先到三楼！
Thirty-five minutes on the clock and four lamp boxes in the way—let's climb up to the third-floor attic next time. See you next time.
回头见！
